dedupe_keys.name: aggregated hourly load and generation profiles for the kurzeme region latvia 2025

description: Anna Mutule and colleagues at Riga Technical University publish hourly electricity load and generation for Latvia’s Kurzeme region. The 8,760-record series spans 1 January to 31 December 2025 and aggregates measurements from 17 transformer substations. Variables are date, time, active generation and load in kW, and reactive generation and load in kVAr. The source reports 553.9 MVA transformer capacity and approximately 189.9 MW connected generation, including solar, wind, cogeneration, hydro and batteries. Zenodo supplies an XLSX file openly without charge; no reuse licence is given in the native metadata. Coverage is the aggregate region, with individual-substation series explicitly excluded. The related MOPO energy-planning dataset has broader geographical and modelling scope for electricity simulations. A limitation is that measurement quality, missing-data handling and time-zone conventions were not checked. No power values were downloaded.
